response: Yes, biofeedback training of psychophysiological responses can enhance athletes' sport performance. Biofeedback training helps athletes become aware of and control their physiological responses, such as heart rate, blood pressure, and muscle tension, which can improve their focus, reduce anxiety and stress, and optimize their physical performance. By learning to self-regulate these responses, athletes can enhance their overall performance, gain a competitive edge, and improve their resilience to pressure and stress.
